subtitle: Outdoor activity rain-conflict planning with human approval
description: Unpublished local build. Choose a city, enter a primary outdoor activity and a same-day availability window, or ask AI to prepare a review-only draft with up to four related same-city plans. Related rescheduling needs a complete change preview and separate explicit approval, then each local write is independently verified. Partial or unknown outcomes stop further steps; restart never replays an old approval. City mode supports China / Asia/Shanghai only. Open-Meteo supplies city lookup and live weather. View deterministic candidates or ask the host-selected Agent; both share the same constraints, human approval and independent persisted read-back. No external calendar sync. City name goes to geocoding; coordinates go to weather; private activity context reaches the Provider only through the Agent path after host consent.
release_notes: Local Stage 3: reuse the same approval, unique schedule writer and execution receipt for sequential approved related-plan changes. Per-plan read-back, partial failure and read-only restart reconciliation. No atomic transaction or external calendar sync. Not a public release; screenshots show the earlier core flow.
